description: Mariano and his gang had laid two traps for the girl with the gun relic. Once he realized that the assassin sent out to kill the girl as part of his first plan had failed, he took hostage a boy belonging to a tribe of local sanctuary guardians, and then waited for his prey. However, that plan failed as well, and he was ultimately forced to fight her face to face. Although Mariano was quite skilled in combat, he was no match for the girl with the gun relic and her comrades in arms. Following his gang's bitter loss he was arrested by the sheriff, but was able to break free during a scuffle on their way to the county jail. This allowed him to rendezvous with his lover and escape into the sunset.
summon: Well, well. Guess now you're a hotshot too, huh?But don't forget, the only person who gets to order me around is my lady.Got it?
fusion: So you're quite the fighter, eh?Alright then, let's call it a draw.What is it you want from me? Just name it.
evolution: There's nothing left to do here.Time to hit the next town.This is goodbye, so you're on your own now, kid.
